description: Create and pay for a Premier Letters order — a real, handwritten letter mailed via USPS. Requires a Premier Letters API key. Use get_pricing or preview_letter first to confirm the price. For payment, "card_on_file" charges the caller's saved card immediately, "balance" pays from the prepaid account balance (no small-order handling fee; fails with insufficient_balance when short), or "checkout_session" returns a checkout_url for the human to complete payment in a browser. Envelope orders use return_address if given, otherwise the account's default return address; with neither, set no_return_address_ack: true to send without one.

idempotency_key.description: Client-supplied key (1–255 chars). Repeating a call with the same key returns the original order instead of creating a second one. Always set this when you might retry.

message.description: The letter text. Supports {{first_name}}, {{last_name}}, {{greeting}} merge fields per-recipient.

no_return_address_ack.description: Send with no return address at all. Only honoured when no return_address is given and the account has no default. Undeliverable mail is then destroyed.

options.description: handwriting_style, paper_type, product_type, mailing_option, authenticity_preset, include_letter, include_envelope, copies, output_mode ("handwritten" default, or "printed_bw" / "printed_color" to print the letter body) and envelope_output_mode (null default = hand-addressed, or "printed_bw" / "printed_color") — see /openapi.json for the full field list.

recipients.description: One or more recipients. At least one is required unless options.product_type is a letter/card with no envelope.

return_address.description: Return address written on the envelope. Omit to use the account's default return address. Required unless the account has a default or no_return_address_ack is true.

skip_invalid.description: When true, invalid recipients are skipped instead of failing the whole order.

name: create_order
